definitions.gloss: oligopoly; market domination by a small number of firms
definitions.explanation: An economic condition in which a market is controlled by a small number of companies or sellers. A key concept in economics and competition law.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寡占|かせん}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This industry is in an oligopolistic state.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧3⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{寡占|かせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The oligopoly by the three major companies continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少数|しょうすう}→少数：05611_shousuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦キャリア→キャリア：10821_kyaria⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{寡占|かせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{新規参入|しんきさんにゅう}→新規参入：17044_shinkisannyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the mobile phone market, an oligopoly has formed among a small number of carriers, making it difficult for new entrants.

notes:
Compound of {寡|か} ('few') and {占|せん} ('occupy; monopolize'). Literally 'occupation by few,' which neatly captures the concept of oligopoly. An important term in economics education and business news.

USAGE:
Frequently appears in economic analysis, news articles about market concentration, and competition law discussions. The term contrasts with ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧ ('monopoly,' domination by one) and {完全競争|かんぜんきょうそう} ('perfect competition,' many sellers). Most real-world markets fall somewhere between {寡占|かせん} and {完全競争|かんぜんきょうそう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寡占|かせん}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: oligopolistic market
- {寡占|かせん}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: oligopolistic conditions
- {寡占|かせん}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: oligopolistic structure
- {寡占|かせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: oligopoly advances
- {寡占|かせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: to break up an oligopoly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧: monopoly — market control by a single entity; more extreme than {寡占|かせん}
- {複占|ふくせん}: duopoly — market dominated by exactly two firms; a specific case of {寡占|かせん}
- ⟦{下線|かせん}→下線：00190_kasen⟧: underline — homophone with different kanji; completely unrelated
- ⟦{河川|かせん}→河川：13276_kasen⟧: river — another homophone; also unrelated
